description: This Java class, LocalizationTool, extends ResourceTool to facilitate access to resource bundles and message localization, with custom handling for locales and resource loading.

classes.name: LocalizationTool
classes.description: A utility class for accessing and formatting localized messages from resource bundles, with custom resource loading behavior.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Overrides the base method to set the locale for resource lookups.

methods.name: getDefaultResourceBundle
methods.description: Returns the default resource bundle, loading it lazily for the English locale.

methods.name: getBundle
methods.description: Overrides resource bundle loading to support custom resource bundle retrieval with locale handling.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a message for a given code, falling back to English if the message is blank.
